title: Keep each region's crews and the spares in stock

expected.says: Run's report for the tiny fleet matches the expected report

blueprint.signature: def build(fleet: list[Transformer], request: Request) -> Built
blueprint.contract: As before, plus: when request.crew_weeks is set, a row `crews_<region>_<year>` for each region with candidates, keeping the summed crew-weeks (KINDS[kind].crew_weeks) of its replacements that year within crew_weeks; when request.lead_times is set, a row `spares_<kind>` for each kind with candidates and plan years before FIRST_YEAR + KINDS[kind].lead_years, keeping the replacements of that kind in those years within request.spares.get(kind, 0).
blueprint.idea: Each resource is one more knapsack row over the same start-year variables; a lead time turns early replacements into draws on a stock.

lesson.title: 14.3.4 Crews, Lead Times and Spare Units

cases: a region has only its crew-weeks each year
short crews push work into later years
a unit needed before its lead time must be a spare, and no spares listed means none in stock
